name: jev
description: Jev picks the right GPT model and reasoning effort for every Codex task, from published benchmarks.

interface.shortDescription: Checks each new task: do model and effort fit?
interface.longDescription: Type `#jev an` once in a conversation. Jev first decides itself whether a message is a new task; replies like "ok" or "weiter" are left alone. For a new task it classifies the kind and difficulty, a fixed policy picks model and effort from published benchmarks and weighted user evidence, and one line shows whether the current setting fits. Messages are never held; switch in the model menu. `#jev`, `#jev <Text>`, `#jev? <Frage>`, `#jev status`, `#jev aus`. Requires AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY (Vercel AI Gateway); chat excerpts are sent to Jev and may incur charges.
